name: alignify-monorepo
description: Real-time collaborative visual workspace for software architecture and systems design

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=packages/shared-types run build && npm --workspace=packages/ui run build && npm --workspace=packages/protocol run build && npm --workspace=packages/canvas-engine run build
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm --workspace=apps/web run test:ci
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/canvas-engine/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.app.json
